title: 舅舅来了

series.next: Your twenty-first birthday. A storm. Someone knocks: the man from the mudflats.

setting: Your flat in 深圳, Saturday afternoon. 小柏, two smart friends from college, and a view of cranes. Then a knock.

jiujiu.name: 舅舅
jiujiu.en: your uncle, in his work clothes

steps.narr: A year in 深圳. You haven't written home once.

else.narr: You took that day to think, back then. 舅舅 still tells everyone in the village about it.

steps.narr: Saturday. The flat looks out over cranes. 小柏, two smart friends from college, and coffee you're still learning to like.
At the door: 舅舅, in his work clothes, with a bag of dried fish. He has taken his hat off, and doesn't know what to do with it.

say.en: Greet him: 舅舅, what are you doing here?
say.gloss: 舅舅, what brings you here?
say.tip: 您怎么来了？ = what brings you here? Surprise, not a complaint.

ok.zh: 路过。……不是路过。坐了一夜的车。
ok.en: Passing by. ...Not passing by. I was on the bus all night.

fail.en: Have I... got the wrong door?

answers: 舅舅，您怎么来了？快进来坐！
4.gloss: 舅舅, what brings you here? Come in, sit down!

say.en: Introduce him to 小柏: this is my uncle.
say.gloss: 小柏, this is my uncle.
say.tip: 舅舅 jiùjiu = your mother's brother.

ok.en: Hello, Uncle! Sit down, I'll make tea.
I won't sit. My clothes are dirty.

answers: 小柏，给你介绍一下，这是我舅舅。
4.gloss: 小柏, let me introduce you: this is my uncle.

steps.narr: 舅舅 stands by the door. The friends glance at his boots, and then away.

steps.en: Your aunt sent this. Dried fish.

steps.narr: One of the friends laughs at something on their phone. 舅舅 thinks it's at him.

say.en: Answer him: you're doing well, he needn't worry.
say.tip: 过得很好 = getting on well. 您放心 = don't worry about me.

answers: 我过得很好，您和舅妈放心吧。
4.gloss: I'm doing well. You and 舅妈 needn't worry.

steps.zh: 我不该来的。给你丢人了。
steps.en: I shouldn't have come. I've embarrassed you.
And... 何小姐 wants to see you.
That's all I came to say.

say.en: Honour him: he's no embarrassment, he's your uncle. Or walk him to the station.
say.gloss: You're no embarrassment. You're my uncle.
say.tip: 丢人 diūrén = lose face, be an embarrassment. 您不丢人 = you're nothing to be ashamed of.

ok.narr: 舅舅 looks at the floor for a long time.
He sits. He keeps his hat on his knee all through dinner.

alts.en: Or: walk him to the station
alts.gloss: 舅舅, let me walk you to the station.

then.narr: At the station he buys you a can of drink, and won't let you pay.

2.gloss: You're nothing to be ashamed of!

answers: 舅舅，您不丢人，留下来吃饭吧。
4.gloss: 舅舅, you're nothing to be ashamed of. Stay for dinner.

answers: 天晚了，舅舅，我送您去车站吧。
alts.gloss: It's late, 舅舅. Let me walk you to the station.

steps.en: 舅舅 takes the night bus home with a full stomach. The dried fish lasts you a month. 🐟

else.en: The bus pulls out. You stand on the platform long after it's gone, holding a can of drink you never open. 🐟
